maya: Quick sync for Wed deploy window — posting tentative slots. please claim smoke ownership and call out any blockers. :rocket:

jordan: I can take user-search (slot B). planning deploy at 10:15 PT. will run smoke + load sanity. :eyes:

rajesh: I'll handle embeddings-service at 10:30 PT (slot C). sylvia? can you own smoke for embeddings?

sylvia: Yep, I got embeddings smoke. I'll check model latencies and run eval set. rollback plan ok?

rajesh: Rollback plan = pin to embeddings:v2.0, toggle routing back, and clear KV cache. should be < 10m rollback.

oliver: Quick Q: are there any DB migrations in this window? last time we had a small schema patch.

maya: No DB migrations — this is app-only. migrations were moved to next week's maintenance window.

maya: Current tentative schedule:
```
Slot A 10:00 PT - auth-service - deploy: oliver - smoke: oliver
Slot B 10:15 PT - user-search - deploy: jordan - smoke: jordan
Slot C 10:30 PT - embeddings-service - deploy: rajesh - smoke: sylvia
Slot D 10:45 PT - routing-proxy - deploy: maya - smoke: jordan
```

jordan: Suggestion: leave 15m buffer between slots for rollback/fix. we should only start next slot after smoke ✅.

sylvia: Agreed. I'll post a short smoke checklist in the thread (quick items):
```
- verify health endpoints respond (200)
- sample 10 requests through canary path
- p95 latency < 800ms for critical endpoints
- error rate < 2% over 5m window
- confirm logs show model load success
```

maya: Rollback triggers we agree on: failed health checks, error rate spike >2%, or latency regression >30% from baseline. call rollback in thread and ping @oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy schedule created: https://deploys.redwood.internal/schedules/1915012345 (automated note) :robot_face:

oliver: tagging infra — @raja-infra please keep an eye on GPU pool slot C around 10:30 PT.

rajesh: noted. will reserve extra slot for embeddings warmup.

maya: OK locking slots. jordan, rajesh, oliver, sylvia — please confirm you're set or shout if anything changes. I'll update the release board and add smoke owners. :thumbsup:

jordan: Confirmed, I'm set.

sylvia: Confirmed. leaving a heads-up in #eng-oncall before my smoke.

maya: Thanks — wrapping this up. I'll post final pinned checklist 30m before 10:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
